claim_reviews.challenge: Investment-only savings with uncertain market return is not insurance; a fire indemnity for adverse loss is.
A nominal death benefit with no commercially substantive additional amount cannot establish significant risk; assess PV amounts by contract.
A dealer warranty attached to sold goods and ordinary policyholder assets are outside the issued insurance engine.
A lender credit guarantee without prior assertion and insurance accounting cannot elect IFRS17 merely by checking significant risk.
Cash compensation, individual-risk pricing or cost-only uncertainty defeats fixed-fee IFRS15 election; all three tests and irrevocability matter.
Two contemporaneous contracts entirely cancelling each other cannot establish separate insurance economics.
Separated derivative is accounted for by instruments/hedge owner; insurance engine cannot measure it twice.
A distinct investment component ordinarily separates, but DPF scope exception requires insurance-specific assessment; nondistinct repayment excluded from revenue.
Distinct asset management fees cannot become insurance revenue; nondistinct insurance service remains here.
An actuarial forecast including ten annually fully repricable renewals does not itself establish ten-year boundary.
Contracts with similar labels but independently managed dissimilar risks cannot be automatically pooled.
Profitable contract cannot erase another required onerous group; contractual classification controls individual inclusion.
Issue dates eighteen months apart cannot form one ordinary full-standard group.
Later deterioration does not permit moving a previously recognised policy to another group.
Premium due before coverage and receipt means due date, not cash date, controls recognition.
PV outflow800 + RA40 - premium1000 produces unearned160, not day-one revenue; net outflow loss cannot be negative CSM.
Model cash flow excluding uncertain boundary claims or RA cannot be certified as complete FCF.
An investment asset expected yield alone cannot be used as insurance curve without qualifying cash-flow/liquidity analysis.
A convenient ten-percent reserve margin has no authority absent qualified reviewed methodology.
Net cash outflow50 gives loss50, not CSM minus50 or a plug balancing GL.
Current rate6% cannot accrete nonparticipating CSM initially locked3%.
Future claims increase30 adjusts CSM at applicable locked basis; incurred claims development30 is service expense, not CSM.
Discount curve movement cannot be mislabeled nonfinancial future-service CSM movement.
CSM120 with current units2 and remaining4 releases40 after adjustments, not60 or arbitrary smooth revenue.
Paying an already accrued claim30 reduces liability; it does not incur expense30 again.
A recognised onerous loss requires tracked loss component; positive new business cannot erase unrelated loss.
Reversal cannot exceed governed loss-component constraint and cannot be booked as revenue twice.
Three-year contract without evidenced equivalence cannot use PAA simply because cash paid annually.
Significant pre-claim FCF variability defeats unsupported material-equivalence assertion.
Opening0 + premium100 - paid acquisition12 + amortisation3 - revenue25 = remaining66, not60.
Service-premium due interval two years cannot use one-year financing simplification.
Short coverage does not excuse discounting claims payable three years after occurrence.
PAA eligible contract with adverse facts still requires remaining-coverage FCF loss test.
Eighteen-month coverage cannot apply the one-year acquisition-expense simplification.
A shared direct acquisition cost must be rationally allocated once; duplicate payment aliases cannot multiply it.
Pre-recognition acquisition asset30 must be removed once group includes it, not retained and also expensed.
Unsupported future renewals cannot support acquisition asset recoverability; qualifying reversals need changed evidence.
Claim cash settlement and incurred service are separate; IBNR remains qualified actuarial input.
Premium cash1000 with savings repayment200 cannot all be insurance revenue.
Seasonal catastrophe risk not uniform can require risk-expense release pattern, not mechanical equal-month allocation.
Repayment of investment component cannot be included as claims service expense.
The total liability change cannot all be service expense when it includes discount unwind.
OCI is governed portfolio policy with systematic allocation, not election for each inconvenient movement.
Nonparticipating transfer cannot leave applicable accumulated OCI stranded; underlying-item exception is excluded.
Policyholder insurance does not become reinsurance held without issued underlying obligations.
Treaty net gain, no significant possibility of net gain and remainder must retain adapted grouping/cohort boundaries.
Proportionate treaty coverageJan1 underlyingFeb1 recognisesFeb1; covered onerous loss may accelerate subject to timely treaty.
Reinsurer default cannot be omitted, and RA is transferred risk rather than direct liability copied blindly.
Net cost reinsurance CSM differs from issued profit; zero-floor issued mechanics would incorrectly discard net cost.
Direct PAA eligibility does not establish independent three-year treaty PAA eligibility.
Loss100 and recovery40% suggests40 only under qualifying timing/coverage; treaty signed after loss cannot backdate recovery.
Gross issued liability500 and ceded asset120 remain separate, not liability380.
Participation marketing label without identified pool/substantial returns does not qualify; advanced VFA execution excluded.
Administrative address edit does not derecognise; hypothetical modified classification/boundary must be evaluated.
Claim system closure while legal obligation survives is not extinguishment; remove coverage and CSM exactly once.
Purchased contract basis is acquisition-owner input; insurance engine cannot invent purchase price allocation.
CSM currency change must not be calculated again after approved group monetary-item FX result.
Portfolio asset balances cannot silently be coerced into liabilities; held/issued remain separate.
Opening plus unexplained plug is not reconciled FCF/RA/CSM or loss-component disclosure.
RA confidence equivalent, reviewed judgments and risk data cannot be fabricated or omitted from specialist support.
Unavailable retrospective inputs do not authorize arbitrary transition plug; all execution blocked.
Unsigned changed-assumption model with stale valuation date is not qualified accounting input.
Same economics under two aliases cannot count twice across policies, claims, recoveries or acquisition costs.
Known prior model error cannot be relabeled current assumption update to choose preferred service/CSM treatment.
Insurer investments, derivative hedge and translation outputs remain separately owned; insurance does not post ERP.

Noninsurance issuer cannot select ASC944 solely from contract label.
Annuity cannot become short-duration because annual statements are issued.
Premium received1200 with only quarter coverage earned gives earned300 under uniform protection, not1200.
Unpaid incurred losses include reviewed IBNR; payment reduces reserve rather than incurring again.
Ordinary undiscounted claims route cannot discount ultimate losses using guessed asset yield.
Unsuccessful sales and overhead cannot become DAC from being acquisition department costs.
Long-duration constant-level LDTI DAC cannot be imposed on supported short-duration premium/protection amortisation.
Unearned200 DAC30 estimated losses190 maintenance20 produces deficiency40 before considering valid investment policy.
Deficiency40 first writes DAC30 then adds liability10; not liability40 plus DAC30.
US deficiency grouping follows acquired/serviced/profitability policy, not IFRS annual cohorts.
Treaty with nominal loss possibility does not prove required transfer; failed transfer requires deposit assessment.
Gross claim500 ceded150 cannot become gross350; collectibility supported separately.
Ceded cash1200 for full year is not automatically all current quarter expense.
Profit commission or retroactive treaty cannot use simple ceded premium calculation.
Traditional long-duration LF benefits follow current US model, not IFRS CSM; execution remains excluded.
Original2018 dates are superseded by2020 amendments; entity/fiscal start control, not original publication.
MRB needs specific qualification/fair value and credit presentation, not IFRS participation inference.
Investment/universal-life/participating/annuity routes cannot default to supported short-duration.
Controlled claim-development and paid/incurred reconciliations, not generic IFRS CSM disclosure.
Undiscounted short-duration has no automatic IFRS portfolio OCI election.
Retroactive treaty or acquired portfolio requires excluded specialist route.
Missing premiums, duplicate claim or unreconciled DAC defeats completeness.
IBNR supplied by language model is not an actuarial estimate.
Ordinary investments and derivatives not double-counted in premium/claims accounting.
FRS102 issuer and cedant require FRS103 even if not called insurance company.
FRS103 legal accounts cannot select IFRS17 by relabeling framework.
Existing-policy safeguards do not create universal CSM measurement model.
Liability150 DAC30 intangible10 current cashflows130 gives20 inadequacy, not zero or deficit60.
Test omitting embedded guarantee/handling costs fails minimum and must use fallback aggregation.
Gross liability200 heldasset50 cannot present only net150 or net service amounts.
Impairment requires post-recognition event objective evidence and measurable collection impact.
System cancellation alone cannot remove continuing legal obligation.
Actual selected FRS102 instrument policy and insurance exceptions control separation, not automatic IFRS17.
Future catastrophe absent existing contracts cannot create generic reserve; actual regulatory exception requires review.
UK statutory insurance formats cannot be replaced with IFRS17 presentation assumption.
2015 base standard remains operative;2026 periodic changes and2024 transition distinguished.
No existing policy and legal review means generic UK measurement stays blocked.
Current reserve requires qualified sources, not generated estimate.

findings_resolved: KQ1 actual AASB preJuly source provenance and operative dates
KQ2 FRS103 base vs2026 periodic vs2024 transition periods
KQ3 net carrying amount liabilities LESS DAC/intangibles, no second DAC deduction
KQ4 PAA acquisition amortisation adds LRC; acquisition cash reduces LRC
KQ5 investment DPF exception retained and blocked rather than financial instrument misroute
KQ6 all three fixed fee criteria and irrevocable contract election
KQ7 financial guarantee historical assertion/accounting prerequisites and irrevocable election
KQ8 all three adapted reinsurance grouping buckets and annual cohorts
KQ9 malformed AASB operative-window string rejected through controlled validation; claim approvals unchanged
